open_issues.title: Sync 401 heal does not cover stale-but-present Sanctum token
open_issues.description: Commit a46ec7df7 fixes the case where Vuex-persistedstate has not yet restored authToken (skip-tick when Authorization header missing). But when token IS present in Vuex BUT the DB row has been cleaned up by Sanctum expiration sweep, backend returns 401 → axios 401 interceptor fires → store.dispatch('logout') → window.location.href='/login' → loops back through staffOnly landing → admin redirected to /admin/pos-v4 (because dashboardPerm.url=dashboard but session-cleared cache lands wrong route).
open_issues.reproduction: Observed during this test: navigate to /admin/dashboard, wait 5 min idle, navigate to /admin/kitchen-display-system → 401 cascade → redirect loop landing on /admin/pos-v4 unexpectedly.
open_issues.impact: Chef opens KDS board after extended idle (lunch break) → page redirects to POS unexpectedly → has to re-login. Acceptable but mildly confusing.
open_issues.fix_path: Extend skip-tick to also handle 401 response (not just missing header) — retry once with refreshed Vuex token before triggering full logout. Tracked V1.0.2 backlog UNI-15.

open_issues.title: KDS bump events not mirrored to audit_logs HMAC chain
open_issues.description: OrderStateMachine::recordTransition writes to order_status_transitions (append-only, but NOT HMAC chain-signed). Cross-surface forensic queries that join audit_logs would miss kitchen operational events.
open_issues.impact: Operational only — no NF525 fiscal violation since KDS bumps are not fiscal events. But if a future investigation needs end-to-end audit trail (e.g. dispute over which chef bumped what), they'd need to query 2 separate ledgers.
open_issues.fix_path: Wire OrderStateMachine::recordTransition to also emit a corresponding AuditLogService::write entry. Tracked V1.0.2 backlog UNI-16.
